title: Non-current native NAS key set identifier

entities.name: Non-current native NAS key set identifier
entities.description: An information element that indicates the UE has a valid non-current native 5G NAS security context during inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Procedure where UE transitions from S1 mode (E-UTRA) to N1 mode (5G) while in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: 5G Mobility Management connected state where the UE has an established NAS signaling connection.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to initiate registration procedure with the network.

entities.name: Valid non-current native 5G NAS security context
entities.description: A security context that is valid but not currently active, available to the UE.

entities.name: Mapped 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context derived from EPS security context, used to protect NAS messages.

entities.name: Condition for IE inclusion
entities.description: Condition where UE performs inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode in 5GMM-CONNECTED state using mapped 5G NAS security context.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the Non-current native NAS key set identifier IE under specific conditions.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition of inter-system change with specific security context configuration.
The inter-system change condition requires the UE to be in 5GMM-CONNECTED state.
The condition requires the UE to have a valid non-current native 5G NAS security context.
The condition requires the UE to use a mapped 5G NAS security context for protecting the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
The inter-system change procedure includes the condition for IE inclusion as part of its execution.
